title: EXPLAIN type 列优劣阶梯与场景评级
expected_output:
=== EXPLAIN type 列优劣阶梯 ===
  system   0   表只有 0/1 行, 无需索引                      >>>>>>>
  const    1   主键或唯一索引的等值, 优化器确定最多一行                >>>>>>
  eq_ref   2   JOIN 关联列是被驱动表的唯一/主键索引                >>>>>
  ref      3   非唯一索引的等值匹配, 可能多行                     >>>>
  range    4   索引上的范围扫描 (BETWEEN / > / IN / LIKE 'x%') >>>
  index    5   扫整棵索引树 (比 ALL 略好: 通常只读索引页)           >>
  ALL      6   全表扫描, 最差                             >

=== 场景 -> type 判定 ===
SQL 片段                                         type      评级
SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = 5                   const     优
SELECT * FROM t WHERE email = 'a@b.c'          const     优
SELECT * FROM o JOIN u ON o.uid = u.id         eq_ref    优
SELECT * FROM t WHERE city = 'BJ'              ref       优
SELECT * FROM t WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 30    range     可接受
SELECT * FROM t WHERE name LIKE 'zhang%'       range     可接受
SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id                   index     视情况
SELECT * FROM t WHERE nickname = 'x'           ALL       差

必须优化(ALL 全表扫描)的语句数 = 1
   必须优化: SELECT * FROM t WHERE nickname = 'x'
视情况(type=index, 扫整棵索引树)的语句数 = 1
   视情况: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id

要点: ALL = 全表扫描, 必须优化
      type=index = 扫整棵索引树: 若查询本可被 WHERE 大幅过滤却仍是 index 才需优化;
                   若查询本来就要返回全表(无过滤条件), index 属正常
code:
# EXPLAIN 的 type 列, 从优到劣
LADDER = [
    ("system", 0, "表只有 0/1 行, 无需索引"),
    ("const",  1, "主键或唯一索引的等值, 优化器确定最多一行"),
    ("eq_ref", 2, "JOIN 关联列是被驱动表的唯一/主键索引"),
    ("ref",    3, "非唯一索引的等值匹配, 可能多行"),
    ("range",  4, "索引上的范围扫描 (BETWEEN / > / IN / LIKE 'x%')"),
    ("index",  5, "扫整棵索引树 (比 ALL 略好: 通常只读索引页)"),
    ("ALL",    6, "全表扫描, 最差"),
]
RANK = {name: score for name, score, _ in LADDER}

CASES = [
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = 5",                       "const"),
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE email = 'a@b.c'",              "const"),
    ("SELECT * FROM o JOIN u ON o.uid = u.id",             "eq_ref"),
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE city = 'BJ'",                  "ref"),
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE age BETWEEN 18 AND 30",        "range"),
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE name LIKE 'zhang%'",           "range"),
    ("SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id",                       "index"),
    ("SELECT * FROM t WHERE nickname = 'x'",               "ALL"),
]

print("=== EXPLAIN type 列优劣阶梯 ===")
for name, score, why in LADDER:
    bar = ">" * (len(LADDER) - score)
    print("  %-8s %-3d %-36s %s" % (name, score, why, bar))
print()
print("=== 场景 -> type 判定 ===")
print("%-46s %-9s %s" % ("SQL 片段", "type", "评级"))
for sql, tp in CASES:
    score = RANK[tp]
    if score <= 3:
        verdict = "优"
    elif score == 4:
        verdict = "可接受"
    elif score == 5:
        verdict = "视情况"
    else:
        verdict = "差"
    print("%-46s %-9s %s" % (sql, tp, verdict))
print()
must_fix = [sql for sql, tp in CASES if RANK[tp] >= 6]
unavoidable = [sql for sql, tp in CASES if RANK[tp] == 5]
print("必须优化(ALL 全表扫描)的语句数 = %d" % len(must_fix))
for w in must_fix:
    print("   必须优化:", w)
print("视情况(type=index, 扫整棵索引树)的语句数 = %d" % len(unavoidable))
for w in unavoidable:
    print("   视情况:", w)
print()
print("要点: ALL = 全表扫描, 必须优化")
print("      type=index = 扫整棵索引树: 若查询本可被 WHERE 大幅过滤却仍是 index 才需优化;")
print("                   若查询本来就要返回全表(无过滤条件), index 属正常")
